faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I add secrets to a project?
faq.a1: Open the project, go to the "Secrets" tab and click "New Secret". Enter the key and the value. Your secrets are encrypted locally before they are sent.
faq.a2: CriptEnv uses Zero-Knowledge encryption. Your keys are derived locally with PBKDF2 and the data is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before it leaves your device.
faq.q3: Can I use it in CI/CD environments?
faq.a3: Yes! Generate API tokens in the project settings tab and use them in your CI/CD pipelines to access secrets securely.
faq.q4: How does the invite system work?
faq.a4: In the project "Team" tab you can invite members with different permissions: Owner, Admin, Developer or Viewer. Invites expire automatically after 7 days.

security.title: Security first
security.description: Never share your encryption keys or API tokens. CriptEnv never asks for your password or keys over email or chat.
